sections.title: INDICATIONS AND USAGE
sections.text: For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains.

sections.title: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION
sections.text:
Chew 1 to 4 tablets every 4 hours.
Do not exceed 48 tablets in 24 hours.
